title: Combining partially labelled binary datasets: other-class positives as negatives
mechanism: When combining single-class datasets, positives of other classes act as negatives and a binary dataset's background is excluded from loss for classes it does not label.
evidence: +4.4% Dice over a per-class ensemble, 24% less stomach/colon confusion (2D DeepLabV3).
adaptation: For MSS and PV-Vision: their busbar/non-cell positives are negatives for crack except where their crack overlaps; their background ignored for classes they do not label.
min_experiment: Ablation inside the joint run: this masking rule vs naive background, 5 seeds each. Metric: clean-49 crack relP@2 and IoU. Kill if < +0.012 crack IoU. ~10 GPU-h.
